name: prefill_summarize
goal: prefill throughput: one long prompt, short answer
instruction: Summarize the article below in five bullet points and one closing sentence.
notes: The answer is deliberately short so the measurement is dominated by the long prompt. ~1300 words of original prose about container shipping; tokenises to roughly 2k tokens with the Qwen BPE, which is enough for prefill to be several seconds on CPU and long enough that per-forward overhead does not dominate.
